name: Samyak Jain
description: Samyak Jain is the Founder of Fluid and Co-founder of Instadapp, innovating in crypto and DeFi since 2018. He began building in DeFi during college, dropping out after winning the 2018 ETHIndia hackathon with a MakerDAO-based tool. Backed by Pantera Capital, Standard Crypto, Naval Ravikant and others in 2019, he went on to build Instadapp, which evolved into Fluid, the fastest DeFi protocol on Ethereum to reach $100B in volume, with peak TVL of approximately $12B.
